title: Some nights give you nothing.
paragraphs:
Some nights give you nothing.
No progress. No results. No proof it’s working.
But Peter still pushed the boat back out.
What if the breakthrough is waiting on your “one more try”?

Then Jesus said,
“Let the nets down again.”

Sometimes discipline looks like
trying again when you're already tired.
Most people quit at the exact moment obedience begins to matter.

Peter was exhausted.
The nets were empty.
The professionals said the fish weren't there.

“Most breakthroughs look like one more attempt.”
What’s something you’re tempted to quit right now?
